renderings.value: Similarly, the strongest reasons for stopping smoking are usually the short-term benefits (for example, feeling healthier and more attractive).
The management tended to be too concerned about short-term improvement of the bottom line to have any long-term design for the future.
Some people find it easier to grasp the short-term effects of smoking.
Short-term effects of smoking include unfitness, wheezing, a general vulnerability to illness, bad breath, bad skin and so on.
At first they think they won't come to harm, although no smoker escapes at least the short-term effects.
